obligation.cite: P.L. 119-27 (GENIUS Act) §4(a)(3) / 12 U.S.C. §5903 monthly certification & examination
obligation.text: A permitted payment stablecoin issuer shall, each month, have the information disclosed in the previous month-end report required under paragraph (1)(D) examined by a registered public accounting firm. Each month, the Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer of a permitted payment stablecoin issuer shall submit a certification as to the accuracy of the monthly report to, as applicable, the primary Federal payment stablecoin regulator of the permitted payment stablecoin issuer; or the State payment stablecoin regulator of the permitted payment stablecoin issuer.

binds: permitted payment stablecoin issuers (GENIUS); e-money token issuers (MiCA Art 54)

measured_fact.stated_examiner: Deloitte (independent third-party accounting firm / US CPA per docs)
measured_fact.verbatim_quote: Ripple is committed to full transparency of the reserves supporting RLUSD. We provide monthly reserve reports conducted by the independent third-party accounting firm, Deloitte. These attestations validate the circulating supply and assets backing RLUSD. Attestations are performed by an independent Certified Public Accountant (CPA) licensed in the United States. The CPA issues monthly attestation reports pertaining to management’s assertions regarding the amount of RLUSD in circulation, along with information pertaining to the composition of the RLUSD Reserve fund.
measured_fact.factual_limitation_noted: Attestation reports are retrospective and point-in-time (as of named Report Dates), not a continuous real-time reserve feed and not described on the product page as a full financial-statement audit.
